test_batched: test the batched function that splits an iterable into chunks of a given size
create_batched_strings: create a batched call that splits a string into lists of characters with a specified batch size
create_batched_generators: create a batched call that lazily consumes a generator and returns lists of batched items
test_batched_invalid_size: test that batched raises ValueError when given a zero or negative batch size
test_batched_returns_lists: test that batched returns lists instead of tuples unlike itertools.batched
